## Description
Provide a brief summary of the changes made, the rationale behind them, and what specific problem they solve.

## Related Issues
Fixes #[issue number or link]

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update (non-breaking change to docs, readme, or guidelines)
- [ ] Refactoring / Maintenance (code cleanup, performance tuning, linting configurations)

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style guidelines of this project (Ruff for Python, Prettier for JSON/JS/HTML).
- [ ] I have run linting tools (`ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` for Python) and they pass without error.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation (`README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, or specific files in `docs/`) to reflect my changes.
- [ ] I have added/modified relevant test scenarios or performed manual verification.

## Verification & Testing
Describe the verification process and commands used to test the changes (e.g., `docker compose build`, checking container logs, running unit tests, or workflow execution status).
